input_rationale.evolution: The candidate builds on the merged AstrAI GEMV stack and records a rejected M=2 warp-tiling experiment, but has no upstream maintenance history yet.
input_rationale.locality: The CUDA change is isolated to one exact-shape M=4 launcher branch; dispatcher, benchmark, tests, and documentation are separately scoped.
input_rationale.tests: The complete CPU-capable AstrAI suite passed (613 passed, 141 skipped) and the built L20 extension passed 96 GPU tests.
input_rationale.failure: Unaligned K, unsupported M, training/autograd, unmeasured shapes, other architectures, and the sub-threshold LLaMA 2 7B M=4 chain fail closed to the existing path.
input_rationale.contract: The benchmark and tests are digest-bound, but the D3 acceptance contract has not received maintainer review or a seal.
input_rationale.integration: The fast path remains behind AstrAI's existing bf16_gemv primitive and linear backend.
input_rationale.interface: No public signature or environment-variable contract changes; ASTRAI_GEMV modes remain compatible.
input_rationale.lifecycle: The path remains inference-only, uses the current CUDA stream, fuses optional bias, and is CUDA Graph safe.
input_rationale.buildtest: The SM89 extension built without spills in the added kernel, Ruff format/import checks passed, and both local and L20 tests passed.
input_rationale.policy: The candidate adds no dependency and enables automatic dispatch only for measured architecture/M/(N,K) cells.
input_rationale.attainment: Every enabled common-shape chain exceeds the 3% gate; the only sub-threshold M=4 family is explicitly excluded.
input_rationale.coverage: The required NVIDIA L20/SM89 cell was tested; optional A100/SM80 and H100/SM90 cells remain untested and fall back in auto mode.
input_rationale.retention: The exact-shape launcher avoids AstrAI's pre-existing shape bands; their direct benchmark and the regression suite passed.
input_rationale.family: Eleven LLaMA 2/3 and GPT-NeoX matrix shapes plus four dependent synthetic chains cover M=2 and M=4, without claiming a whole-model benchmark.
input_rationale.compile: AOT CUDA compilation completed before timed cases; no compilation is permitted in steady-state timing.
input_rationale.replay: Paired order alternation, warmup, 21 samples, median and p90 are captured, but not seven fresh processes.
input_rationale.load: Distinct-weight dependent chains include Python dispatch; a real LLaMA/GPT service workload was not run.
input_rationale.resource: GPU5 memory and utilization were checked before and after; the co-resident idle AstrAI service remained allocated and is disclosed.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Precompile and steady-state phases are separated, but cold-start latency is not part of the checked-in result.

execution.astrai_lint: ruff format and import-order checks passed
execution.sm89_build: bf16_gemv target built successfully; added M=4 kernel used 42 registers, zero barriers, and zero spills
